summary: Frontend testing of TradeOS PWA install experience. All 7 requested features verified. Landing page shows 'Download App' buttons in header and hero which open a clean minimal PWA install modal. iOS guide correctly shows 3-step visual instructions (Share → Add to Home Screen → Tap Add) when UA reports iOS. Already-installed detection via localStorage causes buttons to switch to 'Open App' which navigates to /app/command-center. Manual fallback state (desktop w/o beforeinstallprompt) shows short, clean instructions with 'Got it' close button. Modal closes on backdrop click and via close/Got it buttons.
critical_code_review_comments: PWAInstallService.isInstalled() relies on localStorage flag 'tradeos_pwa_installed' which can be stale. If a user uninstalls the PWA from their OS, the flag remains true and buttons will still say 'Open App' until localStorage is cleared. Consider re-verifying via getInstalledRelatedApps() on each landing page mount or using a shorter TTL for the flag.

In LandingPage.jsx handleDownloadClick navigates to '/app/command-center' when installed, but if the user is not authenticated they get redirected to /login. This is fine, but on a real installed PWA the user session should typically be preserved. Consider showing a small inline message like 'Opening TradeOS…' before navigation for better UX.

PWAInstallService.js initializes on module load (`init()` at bottom). This is safe but non-idempotent; if the module is HMR-reloaded or accidentally imported twice, duplicate beforeinstallprompt listeners could attach. Consider adding an initialized flag guard.

PWAInstallModal iOS Share icon SVG has an incorrect path — the arrow shape (paths 'M12 3v12' and 'M8 7l4-4 4 4') combined with the tray render nicely, but the standard SF Symbols Share glyph is a square with an up-arrow — current icon is close but a slight visual polish item.

PWAInstallModal manual state text mentions 'browser's address bar' which is a good hint, but there is no explicit button/hint to open the browser menu (three-dot). For non-Chrome browsers (Firefox desktop) users may be confused. This is minor content polish only.
test_credentials: N/A - No auth needed for landing page tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 7 acceptance criteria verified via Playwright with headless Chromium: (1) Header nav 'Download App' button present with data-testid=download-app-btn, (2) Hero section 'Download App' button present with data-testid=hero-download-btn, (3) Clicking either opens data-testid=pwa-install-modal, (4) Modal renders clean/minimal in all states (manual/ios-guide/already-installed), (5) 'Got it' or 'Done' close buttons present per state, (6) getPlatform() correctly detects iOS via UA (verified by overriding navigator.userAgent), (7) isInstalled() correctly returns true when localStorage 'tradeos_pwa_installed' is 'true' — buttons switch to 'Open App' with ExternalLink icon and clicking navigates to /app/command-center. In headless Chromium beforeinstallprompt does NOT fire so we exercise the 'manual' fallback which shows a single clean paragraph plus 'Got it'. iOS guide state shows all 3 steps ('Tap Share', 'Add to Home Screen', 'Tap Add') with Got it button.
rca of the issue: No issues found. All requested PWA installation UX flows work as designed.
